notes.title: Launch sale! Get 40% off now!
notes.notes:
Launch sale! Get 40% off now!
The sale runs from  September 19th to September 27th.
Enjoy a trip around Hakone with a great 40% discount.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187068/35c0b7453ffa9226f2787554f187ea16562c2422.jpg[/img]

The latest title in the Japanese Rail Sim series of live-action train operating games, Japanese Rail Sim: Hakone - Town of Natural Beauty and Hot Springs, is now on sale!

This time you are heading to one of Japan's most popular tourist destinations, Hakone.
Enjoy operating a train while viewing the scenery of Hakon, filmed from the actual operator's cab!
Not only can you operate a train, but the game is also packed with tourist information, giving you a taste of what to expect when visiting Hakone!
